resources.string: Show a small floating screenshot button. A tap captures the screen; a long press scrolls and combines screenshots. Only scroll-area geometry is inspected; no app text is stored or sent.
A tiny, almost invisible button that stays on the edge of your screen.
Scroll and stitch a long screenshot
Move the bubble to either edge

On-device only · No internet permission · No tracking. For accurate scrolling, Android allows FloatShot to inspect scrollable view bounds, but no screen text is read or saved. Pictures go to Pictures/FloatShot.
Long screenshots work best on vertically scrolling pages. Protected screens and certain apps cannot be captured.
The scrolling frames didn’t match safely. No broken image was saved.
The page kept moving or animating. Try pausing animations before capturing.

No scroll detected — saved a regular screenshot
FloatShot screenshot button: tap for screenshot, hold for long screenshot, drag to move
